current_evidence: The council's 'Planning applications forms' page links this Full/Outline/Reserved Matters checklist, plus Householder, Listed Building/CAC and Advertisement checklists, as the current validation checklists. The PDFs carry no date in the text; their content (EIA Regs 1999, Use Classes A3/A4/B1/D2, Conservation Area Consent) points to roughly 2010-2013.

issues.detail: In the Full/Outline/Reserved Matters checklist, every trigger excerpt is shifted by one row: each requirement is paired with the last line of the previous requirement's trigger. Examples: Environmental Statement is given 'All major developments' (that is the Energy Statement trigger; ES actually applies to Schedule 1/Schedule 2 EIA development). Contaminated Land is given 'All applications for Conservation Area Consent' (that is the Heritage trigger; it actually applies to brownfield sites and sites within 250m of landfill). Structural Survey is given 'All large-scale major developments' (that is the SCI trigger). Travel Plan and Tree Survey are given 'New and expanded school facilities'. Parking is given 'All developments on existing playing fields'.
issues.evidence: Source: 'Land Contamination Assessment – All development on brownfield sites... Development on or within 250m of an existing or known former landfill site'; 'Structural Survey – Development involving structural alterations through the conversion of a listed building...'

issues.detail: Thresholds are lost. Affordable Housing (25+ dwellings, or outline residential on 1ha+), Open Space (12+ dwellings, Open Space Network, playing fields), S106 Heads of Terms (12+ dwellings or 0.5ha, major retail/employment, student accommodation), Flood Risk (1ha+ in FZ1, any development in FZ2/3), Air Quality (major development in or adjoining AQMAs) and Noise (B2/B8, D2, A4, residential next to main roads/railways) all have meaningless excerpts such as 'Document/Information Requirement Affordable Housing Statement', 'or more Air Quality Assessment' and 'or location Flood Risk Assessment'.
issues.evidence: Affordable Housing Statement: 'Development involving 25 residential dwellings or more; Outline applications for residential development on sites of 1Ha or more'

issues.detail: Full planning is marked '(none)' (no local requirements), but the source checklist is explicitly for 'Full/Outline Planning Application and Approval of Reserved Matters'. All about 25 local requirements were placed only under Outline and Reserved matters. Many requirements (e.g. Landscaping Details: 'All full applications... for major developments') apply primarily to Full applications.
issues.evidence: Checklist title: 'Application Validation Checklist – Full/Outline Planning Application and Approval of Reserved Matters'

issues.detail: The checklists repeatedly defer to a separate 'Nottingham City Council Validation Requirements for Planning Applications' document for definitions of 'major' and the TA/Travel Plan thresholds, and for landfill/telecoms requirements. That document is not linked from the current forms page and was not captured, so Grokbot's capture of the local list is incomplete. Grokbot's 'Telecommunications supplementary information' row is only a cross-reference sentence, not a requirement.
issues.evidence: 'please refer to the Validation Requirements for Planning Applications document to ensure that you have supplied all necessary...'

issues.detail: The list date 2012-11-01 comes from PDF CreationDate metadata, not from the document text. The checklists show no adoption or publication date. The date should be marked unknown/undated, though the content clearly predates the 2020 Use Classes changes and is very out of date.
issues.evidence: Date basis: 'PDF metadata CreationDate'; checklist cites 'Environmental Impact Assessment ... Regulations 1999' and 'class A3, A4, A5, B1'

issues.detail: These requirements are absent or mislabelled. Site Waste Management Plan ('All major developments') is mapped to Waste/Refuse storage and is mixed up with the S106 trigger. Open Space Assessment (12+ dwellings, Open Space Network, playing fields) is mapped with the Parking trigger. Biodiversity Survey triggers (within 100m of SSSI/SINC/LNR/Ancient Woodland, all major developments, loft conversions/roof works to listed buildings, demolition) are mislabelled as 'Biodiversity Checklist / Questionnaire'.
issues.evidence: 'Site Waste Management Plan – All major developments'; 'Biodiversity Survey and Report – All developments within or with site boundaries within 100m of SSSIs, SINCS...'

issues.detail: Several items are boilerplate rather than requirements. The only tab_item is a contact statement (phone/email for Development Management). The 'Planning Statement' row is advice that a comprehensive planning statement may cover several items. The 'Pre-application advice' row is the sentence saying a document may be needed if pre-app advice says so. Neither is a listed requirement in the checklist.
issues.evidence: tab_items: 'please contact Development Management on 0115 8764447, or by email to development.management@nottinghamcity.gov.uk'

issues.detail: Under Advertisement consent, 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' and 'Lighting Assessment' are the same source row, with an identical trigger excerpt. Parking and Open Space also share one excerpt, as do Waste and S106.
issues.evidence: 'Lighting Assessment Required for all applications for illuminated advertisements.' (used twice)

issues.detail: The Listed Building/Conservation Area Consent checklist items are reused under 'Demolition in cons area'. Conservation Area Consent was abolished in 2013 and is now planning permission for relevant demolition, so this mapping is approximate. The Heritage Statement trigger 'all Listed Building/Conservation Area Consent applications' is correct for LBC.
issues.evidence: 'Heritage Statement Required for all Listed Building/Conservation Area Consent applications.'

summary: Grokbot's link is the council's current Full/Outline/RM checklist (undated, c.2012). The extraction is badly misaligned: every trigger is shifted one row, thresholds are lost, Full planning is wrongly shown as having no local requirements, and the parent 'Validation Requirements for Planning Applications' document is not captured.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
